correctness.rationale: The positive double-binomial formula has a unique interior entropy saddle at (3/4,3/4); uniform Stirling and two-dimensional lattice Laplace evaluation give A_n ~ (2 sqrt(6)/(3 pi^2))64^n/n^2. Combining this with the exact Casoratian gives the leading increment of C_n/A_n, and summing its positive geometric tail yields the stated sqrt(2) pi^3/84 constant. Exact recurrence, binomial, and Casoratian checks plus high-precision scaled diagnostics agree.

originality.rationale: The inspected Bachmann preprint proves the zeta(3)/7 limit and supplies the binomial and Casoratian identities, but no asymptotic for A_n or sharp 64^{-n} quotient-error constant was located. Searches by recurrence, initial coefficients, AESZ number, limit, and both closed constants found no prior statement. The Sato--Tasaka work cited by Bachmann as in preparation remains the principal residual risk, and older Calabi-Yau Apéry-limit literature was not exhaustively checked for the exact constant.

value.rationale: The result turns a qualitative Apéry limit into a sharp exponential approximation law with a closed leading constant and simultaneously evaluates the dominant AESZ no. 28 solution. The binomial-saddle plus exact-Casoratian method is reusable for other recurrence quotients with comparable structure.
